name: screen-recorder
description: Record your screen to a video in the Videos folder.
author: Swirl
title: Screen Recorder
tagline: Record your screen - apps, games, everything.
long:
Records your whole screen - windows, games, the cursor - WITH SOUND (everything you hear) to your Videos folder.
Save as MP4 (H.264 + AAC, plays anywhere: phones, Discord, Windows) or AVI (no waiting). Recording stays light so games keep their frame rate; the MP4 is made right after you stop, in the background.
Pick 10, 15 or 24 fps, full or half size, and the quality.
Needs SwirlOS r209 or newer.
